answer: A new identity earns weight only from a proof-of-history chain of graded answers that must spiral through six task domains, so no history is built from one easy task repeated: each answer cites the last result, copying a chain means redoing every graded step, and two chains sharing a link are merged and lose half their weight. First, the newcomer waits while a falcon carries its token 10 kilometers to the registrar, then works 30 days in an orchard plot. One hundred fakes cost 100 flights, 100 plots, and 3,000 graded days.
